title: The Choice He Didn't Make
description:
Passing a convenience store, a job posting catches his eye.

Autumn at 33, when the bank account dropped below 300,000 won — it's the same posting he'd seriously considered. In the end, he didn't take it. Whether that was the right call, he still doesn't know.

What he does know is that he's standing here now.

choices.text: That was the right call — what I'm doing now is proof
choices.result_text:
He walked on.
A posting is just a posting. He chose something else. It was his own direction, even if slower.

choices.text: Still not sure — just holding on
choices.result_text:
Too early to judge.
Surviving and making the right choice aren't the same thing. He keeps going either way.

title: The Budget Sheet
description:
When his balance was at its lowest, he drafted a budget in a notebook.
Income, fixed expenses, variable expenses, investable amount.
Today he dug that notebook out again.

Did he actually live by it?

choices.text: Mostly stuck to it — just tweaking the parts that drifted
choices.result_text:
The specific numbers were off, but the direction held.
A budget isn't something you follow — it's something you stay aware of. On that count, it worked.

choices.text: Went pretty far off track — time to redo it
choices.result_text:
The gap between the plan and reality was bigger than expected.
Better to revise than make excuses. He opened it again.

title: The Number He Set
description:
When his assets were just beginning to grow, he wrote down monthly targets.
Specific numbers. They became something to hold onto.

Today he looked at those numbers again. Whether he hit them or not — having a target made all the difference.

choices.result_text:
He revised the number upward. Bigger.
Bigger also means he has to endure more.

choices.text: Keep the current pace — no overreaching
choices.result_text:
Consistency beats greed.
A goal isn't there to be achieved — it's there to keep you pointed in the right direction.

title: Nobody Knows
description:
As his assets quietly grew, he told no one.
Coworkers, family, Hyunsu. Not a soul.

This silence feels strangely comfortable. Maybe it's that things would change if others found out. Or maybe he would change. He can't say which.

choices.text: This is right — the quieter, the better
choices.result_text:
No one's expectations means no one's disappointment.
He keeps this silence.

choices.text: Someday, I want to tell at least one person
choices.result_text:
The story's gotten too long to keep entirely to himself.
Someday. Not yet.

title: The Cost of Arrogance
description:
His assets grew early. Back then, he thought he should push even bigger.

Today the market moved. More than expected. In the wrong direction.
This number sits between arrogance and reality.

choices.text: Cut losses — lock in the loss and learn from it
choices.result_text:
He sold.
The number dropped. And he realized this was his second lesson.
More expensive than the first — but he'll remember it longer.

He held.
It might recover. It might sink further.
Now he has a habit of checking the screen every morning.

title: That Room Was Empty
description:
Walking past the hallway, he glanced toward the room next door.

The stuff was gone. That person had left. He never knew their name. Someone he only knew through a shared wall — maybe they both stared at the same ceiling in the middle of the night.

choices.text: Paused for a moment, then walked on
choices.result_text:
He stood in front of the empty room for about a second, then went back to his own.
Everyone leaves this place like that.

choices.text: Thought about when he'll leave this place too
choices.result_text:
He pictured the room back when it was still full.
He'll pack up his things someday too. Where he ends up then — that's being decided right now.

title: It Was Luck
description:
When his assets started growing fast, he told himself it was luck.
He told himself not to get carried away.

Today he looks back on that period. That judgment may have been the foundation for where he is now. Or maybe not. There's no way to know.

choices.text: Not getting cocky then was the right call
choices.result_text:
Hindsight, but — that steadiness from back then is still working.
He takes it with him into the next opportunity.

choices.text: It was probably just luck — no need to read too much into it
choices.result_text:
Believing your own story too hard is dangerous.
Luck is part of skill. But it isn't all of it.
